in_marathi.name: Nrusingha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Nrsi + Ishvara: God in human form
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nrusingha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nrsi: Lord Narasimha, a form of Vishnu; Ishvara: God in human form. Narasimha is a manifestation of Vishnu, who saved the world from a demon, Hiranyakashipu. He appeared in a half-lion, half-human form to protect his devotee, Prahlada. The name Nrusingha signifies God appearing in human form for the protection and salvation of His devotees.
